d: Countrymen dance a kind of counter, the older ones sit side by side on benches and watch. Baculus and Gretchen dance in the middle. On a table sideways the musicians sit. The dance ends with a group, then general choir
Baroness in men's dresses, appears from the opposite side
Baroness. Nanette, also in men's dresses
Pancratius sits in front of the open door on the right, behind him the servants of the castle: served, cooks, hunters, girls etc. Some of them have fallen asleep. Later Baculus
Countess and Baron stepping out of the side door in conversation
The previous ones in the arbour. Young girls from the village, decorated and wearing garlands, appear
